note: Stock FurnitureFactoryWindow btn_add path: MID1845 is sent parameterless from the window's confirm alert callback (w.rightBtn.callback runs the stock onRegister handler). VIP1 is imported by the existing provisioner through the production privilege owner; MID1 buy_glue_times comes from the registered GlueBootstrap. First purchase, relogin reload, second purchase to the VIP1 cap, then the stock client-side cap guard leaves the counter unchanged. The window right button is a SpriteNodeButton with no scene node name, so the scenario invokes its registered stock callback instead of a coordinate tap. The final click uses a pass-through observer on WindowManager.openWindow to assert the exact stock BUY_GLUE_VIP_NOT_ENOUGH toast despite its 1.5-second lifetime, restores the original method, and refuses an unexpected confirmation window. This is test instrumentation, not a replacement for the stock guard.
